purpose: Capability-first Frankenstein/EntityOS repository entry contract. No root scan, guessed path, provider call, secret lookup, or self-attested NATIVE promotion.

authority.current_state_rule: Refresh current main, CLAY_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY.md, research_entity/claycode/autonomous/SUPERVISOR_INBOX.json, and the steering selected by that inbox before execution or present-tense authority claims.

NATIVE.meaning: Required lifecycle, durable-state, and claimed effect/result boundaries work through the host's normal integration path and were independently observed at the claimed scope.
minimum_evidence: receipt produced by the lifecycle mechanism itself
durable state survives the required restart/re-entry boundary when persistence is claimed
actual effect/result receipt plus outcome re-entry when effects are claimed
forbidden_shortcuts: requested write without observed durable write
manually authored receipt that is not produced or verified by the claimed lifecycle/effect mechanism

classification.ADAPTED: Equivalent useful behavior is verified through a host-specific adapter, while one or more native lifecycle boundaries are absent or not native.
classification.DEGRADED: Useful subset works, but one or more required lifecycle/state/effect capabilities are absent or remain unverified.
classification.BLOCKED: A required capability or current authority is absent, denied, ambiguous, or cannot be safely established.

host_routes.claude_code: Detect actual checkout, shell, hook, durable-state and receipt behavior; do not infer from product name.
host_routes.codex_cli: Detect actual checkout, shell, hook, durable-state and receipt behavior; do not infer from product name.
host_routes.hermes_agent: Detect actual workspace/tool/lifecycle surfaces; missing persistent lifecycle is DEGRADED or ADAPTED, not NATIVE.
host_routes.chatgpt_web: Use actually connected repository/file/tool surfaces; source writes are not runtime installation and no local daemon is assumed.
host_routes.claude_web: Use actually exposed project/file/tool surfaces; no local path, hook or runtime is assumed.
host_routes.grok_web: Use actually exposed project/file/tool surfaces; no local path, hook or runtime is assumed.
host_routes.generic: Probe capabilities first and classify only from observed boundaries.

acceptance_sequence: trigger the real lifecycle boundary if native lifecycle is claimed
verify durable state across required re-entry if claimed
verify actual effect/result and outcome re-entry if effects are claimed
classify exactly NATIVE, ADAPTED, DEGRADED, or BLOCKED
record missing/unverified boundaries without upgrading them
evidence_boundary: This contract and the discovery helper define/inspect an installation surface only. They mint zero provider-runtime, whole EntityOS/HCU, full HCU, GRID10, Global J-Space, model, or training credit.
